name: sloyui
description: An agent-friendly React UI library with themes, semantic tokens and accessible components.

scripts.tokens: node figma/token-system-v4/build.mjs && node figma/token-system-v4/verify.mjs && node figma/token-system-v4/build-explorer.mjs && node figma/color-system-v2/build-native.mjs && node figma/color-system-v2/verify-native.mjs && node scripts/build-tokens.mjs && node scripts/build-figma.mjs
scripts.build: npm run tokens && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run tokens && npm run verify:custom && npm run verify:alpha && npm run manifest && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:demo
scripts.release:develop: npm run check && npm run pack:kit && npm run verify:package && bash scripts/deploy-devos.sh devos
scripts.verify:custom: node figma/color-system-v2/export-custom.mjs --out artifacts/custom-verification && node figma/color-system-v2/verify-custom.mjs artifacts/custom-verification/graph.json
scripts.verify:alpha: node --test scripts/verify-alpha-recipes.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-alpha-recipes.mjs --domain native --out artifacts/alpha-recipes/core.json
